name: Wake Up Babe
aka: Wake Up Babe, New X Just Dropped
look: A watermarked stock photo of a bright bedroom: a smiling bearded man in a white T-shirt leans over a woman asleep on white pillows, gently waking her. Potted plants sit on the windowsill behind them.
use: Announces something new with mock urgency, as if it's worth waking your partner for. The caption reads "wake up babe, new ___ just dropped", naming a fresh meme, update, product or bit of drama.
